description:
NEXUS NOVA – Connecting Minds. Exploring Infinity.

What happens to the things we leave behind when humanity reaches for the stars? Every piece of equipment abandoned on the Moon and Mars carries a story of human curiosity, sacrifice, and discovery. Our mission is not simply to show what humanity left behind, but to remind the world of the dreams, determination, and incredible achievements that took us there.

Because not everything left behind is forgotten. Some things become part of our legacy.
